description: This file defines a stateless text transformation processor class for the Pipecat framework, which applies user-defined transformation functions to text frames, supporting both synchronous and asynchronous functions.

classes.name: StatelessTextTransformer
classes.description: A processor class that applies transformation functions to text frames, intercepting TextFrame objects and applying a user-provided function, which can be synchronous or asynchronous.

methods.name: __init__( self, transform_fn: Union[Callable[[str], str], Callable[[str], Coroutine[None, None, str]]] )
methods.description: Initializes the transformer with a user-provided transformation function.

methods.name: process_frame(self, frame: Frame, direction: FrameDirection)
methods.description: Processes individual frames, applying the transformation to TextFrame objects and passing others through unchanged.
